milestone: M11-G9 -- Offline Competency Extractor V3 Feasibility
acquisition_method: WebSearch + WebFetch against live public job-board postings (jobs.lever.co), November 2026
exclusions: No M11-D, M11-F, or M11-G5 company reused (confirmed exclusion list checked: Zoox, Avertium, Octave Federal/Hexagon US Federal, Canonical, Mainspring Energy, Venus Aerospace, Array Labs, CesiumAstro, Spry Methods, ShyftLabs, Deliverect, Kitware, Rover.com, FieldAI, Vida Health [backend role already used in M11-F -- a DIFFERENT Vida Health role, Senior Data Engineer, is used here and is a distinct posting/URL, domain, and text; flagged for transparency], Multiply Labs, Paytm, Wealthfront, Artera, Alluxio, Zanskar, Aquabyte, Hermeus, Penumbra, Reply, Element Solutions, Sonar, VGS, Wave HQ, IFM, Makpar, Humble Robotics, 360Learning, Vendavo). No posting text overlaps any prior milestone's corpus.
known_reuse_disclosure: Vida Health (company) appears in both M11-F (m11f-15-vida-backend.txt, 'Backend Software Engineer II - Data Platform', collected 2026-11-03) and this corpus (m11g9-dev-03-vidahealth-dataeng.txt, 'Senior Data Engineer - Data Platform', collected 2026-11-06). These are two distinct, separately-URLed job postings at the same employer, not a duplicated control. Disclosed rather than silently reused; if this is judged unacceptable, this single dev-set posting should be dropped (it is DEV, not sealed holdout, so dropping it carries no holdout-integrity risk).
acquisition_note: jobs.lever.co postings were again markedly more durable than other boards (consistent with M11-D/M11-F/M11-G5 prior experience). 4 of 18 initially located lever.co URLs (Coderio, Daily Wire, Kpler x2 URLs, Aircall) returned HTTP 404 by fetch time and were replaced with alternate live postings (Vida Health data-engineering role, Firework data-engineer-intern role, PointClickCare DevOps role) rather than forced through or fabricated.
dev_holdout_split_policy: Split was decided BEFORE any annotation or extractor work began. The holdout set's annotations are frozen (gold_hash_freeze.json) immediately after authoring and BEFORE the v3 prototype (Phase 3) is written. The dev set may be freely inspected and used to shape v3's design; the holdout set must never be optimized against.
